title: wireframe-parity divergence
description: One divergence between the wireframe's intended UI and the as-built UI. Grounding/measurement agents return an array of these; the interview then classifies and prioritizes them.

dimension.description: What kind of parity check produced this divergence

class.description: regression = breaks a settled decision/contract; intended-evolution = build deliberately improved past the wireframe (recorded, not a fault); unspecified = spec never fixed this (out of parity scope); unverified = could not be measured/grounded

severity.description: diverge = breaks a contract invariant or drops a settled decision, or a measured pass→fail flip; drift = outside tolerance but not a contract break; note = within tolerance / informational

decision_ref.description: The settled Decision id / spec section this touches, if any (e.g. D5, §Contract R1). Empty if not decision-anchored.

intended_evidence.description: The intended side: the decided choice, the spec quote, and/or the wireframe's measured number (e.g. 'D5: rail 236px' or 'bands 0->44->76->131, contiguous')

asbuilt_evidence.description: The as-built side: a file:line and/or the app's measured number (e.g. 'FeatureSectionRail.tsx:24 renders 248px' or 'bands gap 12px when scrolled')

state.description: Which state (role x entity) this was observed in, if measured. Empty for state-independent structural findings.

why.description: The consequence — what the user experiences when the build diverges from the decided design

recommendation.description: Concrete next step to restore parity (or to record the intended evolution)

status_color.description: Register color: 🟢 OOTB · 🔵 Config · 🟡 Custom Dev · 🔴 Gap · ⚪ TBD · 🟣 3rd Party

priority.description: Set by the interview. A broken contract invariant or dropped settled decision defaults to P0.

confidence.description: Measured (high) vs. inferred-from-code (medium) vs. unverified (low). Low + high-consequence => open question, not regression.
